environment.description: EKS pod running in private subnet with NAT gateway. Kafka consumer reads from MSK cluster. S3 access via standard regional endpoint. IAM role attached to pod via IRSA with s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::prod-oauth-tokens/*. No network egress restrictions beyond default VPC routing through NAT.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, unrestricted egress to internet
config.s3_access: Regional S3 endpoint, no VPC endpoint
config.kafka: MSK cluster in same VPC, plaintext auth
